setting: the centre of the engine room at the heart of a steampunk airship — the ship's central still-works

elements.desc: a bank of glowing valve-wheels and pinpoint indicator lights

animate.motion: the indicator lights twinkling and pulsing softly

elements.desc: a riveted boiler, its firebox door ajar

animate.motion: the boiler firebox glowing and flickering

elements.desc: a tall speaking-tube and pressure-pipe venting steam

animate.motion: steam rising and curling continuously upward from the vent

elements.desc: a towering brass distillation apparatus of glass reservoirs and copper coils converging on a central DISPENSARY CONSOLE — a brass field test-kit writ large, its wide glass screen showing a density-versus-polarity scatter-plot above a single funnel where the chosen solvent is poured
a cluster of brass pressure gauges and speaking-tubes

animate.motion: the gauge needles twitching and settling

elements.desc: tall glass sight-gauges of coloured solvent

animate.motion: coloured solvent rising and settling in the sight-gauges, faint bubbles drifting up

elements.desc: a riveted bulk-door standing open onto a red-lit hallway leading back to the cargo hold
a second riveted boiler set into the wall

animate.motion: fire inside the boiler flickering and moving

elements.desc: a large glass vessel of thick coloured solvent

animate.motion: thick coloured liquid bubbling and churning gently, small bubbles rising to the surface and popping, the surface rippling continuously

atmosphere: Constant hot amber-and-red furnace glow with brass highlights, heavy haze and steam, thrumming pistons all around, film grain, grand and tense, richly detailed
negatives: No people, no lettering, no captions, no text
